answer: Sybil resistance rests on a vesting-escrow ladder. Each identity routes its first 30 days of payouts into vesting escrow; the contract releases funds only if the ledger shows age >=30 days AND 3 grading shifts; auditors burn escrow on proven sybil links. Spawning n identities freezes 300 units per clone (10/day x 30d), each waiting out its own window, so parallel resets buy nothing; early quit forfeits 50%. Capital grows linearly: 300n. Like an orchard where each willow must grow its own roots, the fable of replanting a thousand trees fails: no sapling skips that season.
